docs.summary: A contiguous range of indices in the parent [`Mesh`](#api~Prowl.Clay.Mesh)'s shared index buffer that all use the same material. One mesh contains one or more sub-meshes, one draw call each.
Offset into [`Indices`](#api~Prowl.Clay.Mesh~Indices) where this sub-mesh's indices begin.
Number of entries in [`Indices`](#api~Prowl.Clay.Mesh~Indices) belonging to this sub-mesh.
Constant added to every index before vertex-buffer lookup. Useful when packing multiple sub-meshes into a single vertex buffer without renumbering indices.
Index into [`Materials`](#api~Prowl.Clay.Model~Materials), or -1 when no material is assigned.
Local-space bounds covering only the vertices referenced by this sub-mesh.
